<quote by="Proposed: Casinea, Seconded: Reikos">To build the Diplomatenschloss in Necropolis.</quote>
==Overview==
* Rebuild a new, [[fortification|fortified]], [[embassy]] for the [[Commonwealth]] in Hedrossan, [[Necropolis]] as per the '''[[For_the_Common_Good#Fighting_Talk|For the Common Good]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
* 50 Thrones disbursed to the [[Senator]] for [[Casinea]]
==Date==
* Summer 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 70 white granite
* 30 weirwood
* 300 crowns
* Six months to complete
* 5 thrones a season upkeep
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Diplomatenschloss}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the [[Ambassador to the Commonwealth]] again has access to [[Ambassador#Mercantile_Support|mercantile support]] and the Diplomatenschloss serves as a rank one fortification in Hedrossan, Necropolis.
